summary: GBT Technologies filed an 8-K disclosing that on November 5, 2026 it acquired a 5% equity interest in No Camera Films, a Wyoming corporation controlled by Mindatorium Inc., via a Subscription Agreement for common stock. Consideration was a $1,000,000 convertible promissory note issued to Mindatorium, bearing 8% simple interest and maturing November 5, 2027. The note converts at a fixed $0.10 per share, subject to a 4.99% beneficial ownership blocker (raisable to 9.99% on 61 days' notice), with proportional split adjustments only. Prepayment requires Mindatorium consent; conversion-price reset and reverse-split protections are notably absent, presenting dilution overhang. Watch dilution math, prepayment constraints, and any further note or equity issuances.
